description: Payment step for an accepted dataset order. Proxy orders up to $10,000 get a Stripe hosted checkout URL that the buyer pays in a browser; 4K, research, and larger orders get a bank-wire invoice emailed to the buyer. Never collect card details in chat. Calling again returns the same checkout or invoice. Payment is not delivery: every paid order is reviewed by hand first.

order_token.description: Private order_token returned by quote_training_dataset. Keep it out of public links and logs.
